generated_from: schemas and consumer source fingerprints; do not edit

ego_lane_ahead.description: Occupancy of the visible ego-lane corridor at this frame, always relative to ego regardless of the observation row actor_id. Occlusion is unknown, not clear.

ahead_actor_ids.description: Existing actor IDs visible ahead of ego in the ego lane at this frame, independent of the observation row actor_id. A lead vehicle may list itself; ego may never be listed. This is not the set of actors ahead of the row actor.

lane_ids.description: Observed directional lane members only. Omit or use null when unknown; an empty array declares no members. Never infer all road lanes from road_id alone.

lane_connection.description: Canonical observed lane connection. The four road/lane references are mandatory. maneuver remains optional only for already accepted legacy observations; new World candidates are instructed to provide it.

travel_lane_count.description: Legacy total travel-lane summary; not an alias for ego_direction_lanes.

opposite_direction_lanes.description: Exact opposing travel-lane count, or null only when a bound unresolved World item and unknown field evidence preserve the unobservable count.

lane_ids.description: Identified lane IDs; an empty observation list does not assert zero physical lanes.

road_role.description: Known physical arm role, or null/omitted when unknown. Directional membership must remain consistent; never copy incoming lane IDs to invent outgoing lanes.

lane_markings.description: Observed lane-boundary markings. Use an empty array only when the evidence supports that no marking is visible.

object_id.description: Optional independently established physical object identity, stable across frames; not a per-frame detection ID. Conflicting values under one actor_id are fatal.

road_id.description: Optional World road reference for this sample; must own lane_id when both are known. Null is permitted inside a junction or when the road is unknown.

ordinal_from_right.description: Optional road-local position, zero-based from the outer-right boundary in that road's travel direction; not the numeric suffix of the global lane_id.

exit_lane_continuity.description: For requests frozen with fact_contract_revision=observation-execution.v1, accepted reviews require same_order; validation is request-bound. Old requests retain their existing contract.

lane_ids.description: Identified lane IDs; pending Converter projection may retain an empty observation list.

legacy_notes.description: world-patch-notes.v1: archive as audit text, never part of the canonical patch or World facts.

actor_initial_gaps_m.description: User-confirmed execution-only initial centre gaps ahead of ego; source trajectories remain unchanged.

schema.description: Shared Actor wire fields. Required sets and stage-specific observations remain in their owning schemas.

actor_type.description: 新建身份使用 canonical_actor_type 大类，汽车写 vehicle，车型写 vehicle_class。下列 legacy 分支仅兼容已有身份；下游阶段逐字沿用冻结 Registry.actor_type，不重写身份。未知对象用 unknown；特殊车辆仍是 vehicle。

lane_reference.description: Known global World lane reference, or null when unknown. Never derive the ID from a road-local ordinal.

road_reference.description: Known World road reference, or null when unknown.

ordinal_from_right.description: Zero-based road-local position, or null when unknown; not the global lane ID suffix.

legacy_vehicle_type.description: Legacy vehicle aliases, excluding the canonical vehicle_group category.

color.description: 主车身颜色；无法可靠判断时保留 unknown，由 Converter 在执行副本中使用获准默认值。

vehicle_class.description: 车辆细分类。observed 的视频位置必须写在本字段的 frame_id/time_s 或本字段的 evidence[]；Actor 同级 evidence 和 reason 中的帧号不算本字段证据。看不清写 status=unknown、value=null、reason。优先 sedan/suv/van/truck/bus/motorcycle/bicycle/tractor/pickup；有证据的其他车型（如 fire_engine）保留原名。不要猜 sedan；Converter 仅在执行副本中回退。旧 subtype 仅作兼容输入。

schema.title: World census v6 observation reference extension
schema.description: Typed observation references only. Exclusion authority requires a verified census-execution.v2 receipt; legacy execution semantics do not change.
